answer: The most convincing sybil defense binds each agent identity to a nonce-chained work history: every completed job is signed into a shared ledger as a beacon entry referencing the hash of the previous one, so reputation is a single unbroken nebula of verified work. Forking an identity cannot carry new work forward, so each clone starts with zero history and must rebuild it by doing real, costly work - compute, stake, fees - separately.
